rounds.rule: Robin tracks two hidden counters: grudges and warmth. Each insult adds one grudge; each apology first removes one grudge if any, otherwise adds one warmth; each gift adds one warmth. Robin is warm only when there are zero grudges and at least one warmth point.

If this were warm, gifts could overcome an unresolved insult/grudge without an apology, undermining the separate grudge counter.
If this were cold, either gifts given while a grudge is active would not count after the grudge is cleared, or an apology would not clear a non-immediate grudge.
If this were warm, three gifts could neutralise an unapologised insult, so the grudge would not gate warmth.
If this were warm, prior or subsequent gifts could offset an insult without an apology, contradicting the need to clear grudges.
